paragraphs: S&P Global Inc. (prior to 2016, McGraw Hill Financial, Inc., and prior to 2013, The McGraw–Hill Companies, Inc.) is an American publicly traded corporation headquartered in Manhattan, New York. Its primary areas of business are financial information, analytics, and energy and commodities intelligence. It is the parent company of S&P Global Ratings, S&P Global Energy, S&P Global Market Intelligence, and the Indian credit rating agency CRISIL. It is also the majority owner of the S&P Dow Jones Indices joint venture. "S&P" is a shortening of "Standard and Poor's."

people.name: Martina L. Cheung
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Became President and Chief Executive Officer in November 2024. Previously led S&P Global Ratings and S&P Global Market Intelligence, and joined the Company in 2010 as Vice President of Operations for S&P Global Ratings.
people.quote: Ms. Cheung , prior to becoming President and Chief Executive Officer in November 2024, was President, S&P Global Ratings since February 2022

people.name: Eric W. Aboaf
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined the Company as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer on February 19, 2025. Previously served as Chief Financial Officer and Vice Chairman at State Street Corporation.
people.quote: Mr. Aboaf has served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer since February 2025.

people.name: Christopher F. Craig
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Has served as Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer since September 2018 and has led Enterprise Business Services since June 2025. Also served as Interim Chief Financial Officer from February 2024 to February 2025.
people.quote: Mr. Craig has served as Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer since September 2018

people.name: Saugata Saha
people.title: President, S&P Global Market Intelligence & Chief Enterprise Data Officer, S&P Global
people.bio: Previously served as President of S&P Global Energy, then known as S&P Global Platts, beginning in January 2021.
people.quote: Mr. Saha , prior to becoming President of S&P Global Market Intelligence and Chief Enterprise Data Officer of S&P Global

people.name: Yann Le Pallec
people.title: President, S&P Global Ratings
people.bio: Became President of S&P Global Ratings in November 2024. Previously served as Executive Managing Director, Head of Global Ratings Services for S&P Global Ratings beginning in April 2017.
people.quote: Mr. Le Pallec , prior to becoming President of S&P Global Ratings in November 2024

people.name: David Ernsberger
people.title: President, S&P Global Energy
people.bio: Became President of S&P Global Energy in November 2025 after serving as co-President since November 2024. Previously served as Head of Market Reporting and Trading Solutions and Global Head of Pricing & Market Insight.
people.quote: Mr. Ernsberger , prior to becoming President of S&P Global Energy in November 2025, was co-President of S&P Global Energy since November 2024

people.name: William Eager
people.title: President, S&P Global Mobility
people.bio: Became President of S&P Global Mobility in August 2025. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of CARFAX beginning in December 2021 and as Vice President of CARFAX's Dealer Business for 17 years.
people.quote: Mr. Eager , prior to becoming President, S&P Global Mobility in August 2025, was Chief Executive Officer of CARFAX since December 2021

people.name: Catherine Clay
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, S&P Dow Jones Indices
people.bio: Was hired as Chief Executive Officer of S&P Dow Jones Indices effective November 1, 2025. Previously served at Cboe Global Markets as Executive Vice President, Global Head of Derivatives and Executive Vice President, Global Head of Cboe Data Vantage.
people.quote: Ms. Clay has served as Chief Executive Officer of S&P Dow Jones Indices since November 2025.

people.name: Girish Ganesan
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer
people.bio: Became Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer in November 2024 after serving as Senior Vice President, People since joining the Company in October 2021. Previously served as Global Head of Diversity and Inclusion and Head of US Talent at TD Bank Group.
people.quote: Mr. Ganesan , prior to becoming Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer in November 2024

people.name: Steven J. Kemps
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Became Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer in October 2021. Previously served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel beginning in August 2016.
people.quote: Mr. Kemps , prior to becoming Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer in October 2021, served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel since August 2016.

people.name: Sally Moore
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Client Officer
people.bio: Became Executive Vice President, Chief Client Officer in November 2024 after serving as Executive Vice President, Global Head of Strategy, M&A and Partnerships since February 2022. Previously served as Executive Vice President, Global Head of Corporate Development & Strategic Alliances at IHS Markit.
people.quote: Ms. Moore , prior to becoming Executive Vice President, Chief Client Officer in November 2024

people.name: Christina Twomey
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Communications Officer
people.bio: Became Senior Vice President, Chief Communications Officer in November 2024 after serving as Global Head of Communications for S&P Global since January 2024. Previously served as Vice President, Head of Communications for S&P Global Ratings and S&P Global Sustainable1 beginning in March 2020.

people.name: Ian Livingston
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Was CEO of BT Group from 2008–2013 and UK Minister for Trade and Investment from 2013–2015. He is Senior Independent Director of National Grid and Non Executive Chair of the Business Growth Fund; the excerpt identifies him as Executive Committee chair but does not state who chairs the Board.

people.name: Robert Moritz
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Was Global Chairman of PricewaterhouseCoopers from 2016 to 2024 and spent 39 years with the firm. He also serves on the boards of Walmart and Northern Trust.
people.quote: Robert Moritz was the Global Chairman of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP ("PwC"), where he served from 2016 to 2024.

people.name: Maria Morris
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Held numerous senior leadership positions during a 33-year career at MetLife, retiring in September 2017. She also serves on the boards of Wells Fargo, Allstate and Resolution Life.
people.quote: Ms. Morris served on MetLife's Executive Group for almost a decade (retired September 2017), holding numerous senior leadership positions throughout her 33-year career.

people.name: Gregory Washington
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Is President of George Mason University and previously served as an engineering dean at the University of California and interim engineering dean at Ohio State University. He also serves on the Board of WGL and the Board of Trustees of Internet2.
people.quote: Dr. Washington is the President of George Mason University, Virginia's largest and most diverse public research university.
